model_output.verdict: A certified elementary teacher whose classroom results and leadership are easy to see.
write_up: This is a strong elementary teaching resume! Your work at Lincoln Heights brings together reading growth, grade-level leadership and support for English language learners. A recruiter can see both your classroom work and your contributions beyond it.

The reading growth line is the model: it names the district assessment, the change and the period measured. Your certification and endorsement are easy to find, and your experience comes before education.

The main detail to add is what you contributed to the behavior support committee. Your resume is ready to compete for elementary teaching roles; how competitive a particular opening is will matter too.

cards.line: - Raised the class's average reading growth on the district assessment from 0.8 to 1.4 grade levels per year over three years
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives a recruiter a concrete measure of your students' reading growth rather than just saying you taught reading.

cards.line: - Served on the school's positive behavior support committee
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see that you joined the committee, but not what you contributed to its work.
cards.example: Served on the school's positive behavior support committee, where I [what you contributed]
cards.question: What did you contribute to the committee's work?

fit.note: Your experience points to elementary classroom teaching, with grade-level leadership and an English Language Learner endorsement. The resume also shows work with families and students outside regular class time.
